fato_historico: 1270: Yekuno Amlak takes the imperial throne of Ethiopia, restoring the Solomonic dynasty to power after a 100-year Zagwe interregnum.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a regal restoration of your inner power, much like an ancient lineage reclaiming its rightful throne. It is a good time to consider how you lead your life with heart and courage. Allow your natural charisma to shine brightly, as the universe invites you to step forward into your own sovereign glory with absolute grace and confidence.
frase_do_dia: True power rises from the depth of a brave and lionhearted spirit.
significado_numero: Represents the completion of a cycle and the beginning of greatness.
conselho: Trust your inner guidance and lead your day with authentic, bold kindness.
